description_en: Queries the information about a workflow
description_zh: 调用GetBusiness查询业务流程的详情
name: GetBusiness

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the ID. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间名称。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The workflow ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html operation to obtain the folder ID
parameters.help_zh:
业务流程的ID，
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html接口获取
parameters.name: business_id

BusinessName.description_en: The name of the workflow. Workflow names must be unique within the same workspace
BusinessName.description_zh: 业务流程名称，同一个项目空间下的业务流程名称必须唯一

Description.example: This is my first business process.

Owner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the workflow owner
Owner.description_zh: 业务流程责任人的阿里云用户ID

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace where the workflow resides
ProjectId.description_zh: 业务流程所在DataWorks工作空间的ID

UseType.description_en: The functional module to which the workflow belongs. Valid values: NORMAL (Data Studio) and MANUAL_BIZ (Manually Triggered Workflow)
UseType.description_zh: 业务流程所属的功能模块，包括NORMAL（数据开发）和MANUAL_BIZ（手动业务流程）

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for troubleshooting when an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: success.

false: failure
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
